args.title: Fix deduplication race condition for concurrent statement uploads
args.body:
File: src/ingest/worker.ts

When two statement uploads are processed concurrently, both query existing transactions in the date range before either has inserted its rows. This causes overlapping days between concurrent uploads to bypass deduplication. The worker should update or coordinate the seen transaction keys across concurrent imports or lock/serialize ingest per account.
